notes.title: The Madness V.0.2.1 update has been released!
notes.content:
[b]The Madness V.0.2.1 update has been released!
Some bugs have been fixed and new systems have been added in this update!

Here is the content of the update:

- A panel that teaches the controls before the game starts has been added.

- Some name bugs have been fixed in the notes.

- Madness system has been added to the game! You need to solve mysteries within 3 minutes.

- Madness duration extension has been added. There are Medicines in some parts of the map. When you use these Medicines, your 3-minute time will be reset.

- What happens when you go mad? The player dies when they go mad. If you cannot find the Medicines in time, your character will die.

- What happens after you die? In answer to the question, If the player does not solve the mysteries in time and does not use the Medicines properly, they die and the game starts over.

Updates are like this. We are trying to keep our game up to date. We are trying to make the player enjoy by putting them in a mystery. New updates will come after this update. [/b]
